## `src/composables/use-midi/use-midi`

### MidiControls

**Kind:** interface

```typescript
export interface MidiControls
```

Reactive state and controls returned by {@link useMidi}.

### useMidi

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function useMidi(): MidiControls;
```

Framework-neutral Web MIDI hook. Requests MIDI access, tracks the available
input/output ports, and can play notes on an output device.

SSR-safe: `isSupported` is `false` and every control is a no-op when the API
or DOM is unavailable.
Automatic cleanup: the `statechange` listener is removed on unmount.

## `src/composables/use-sound/use-sound`

### SoundControls

**Kind:** interface

```typescript
export interface SoundControls
```

Reactive state and controls returned by {@link useSound}.

### useSound

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function useSound(source?: string): SoundControls;
```

Framework-neutral sound playback hook. Plays an audio clip from `source` via
an `HTMLAudioElement` and can synthesize short tones via the Web Audio API.

SSR-safe: `isSupported` is `false` and every control is a no-op when the
relevant browser API or DOM is unavailable.
Automatic cleanup: playback is stopped and any audio context is closed on
unmount.

#### Parameters

| Name   | Type   | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ----------- |
| source | string |             |

## `src/composables/use-speech-recognition/use-speech-recognition`

### SpeechRecognitionControls

**Kind:** interface

```typescript
export interface SpeechRecognitionControls
```

Reactive state and controls returned by {@link useSpeechRecognition}.

### SpeechRecognitionOptions

**Kind:** interface

```typescript
export interface SpeechRecognitionOptions
```

Options applied when starting a {@link useSpeechRecognition} session.

### useSpeechRecognition

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function useSpeechRecognition(): SpeechRecognitionControls;
```

Framework-neutral speech-to-text hook built on the browser's native
SpeechRecognition API (prefixed as `webkitSpeechRecognition` in some
browsers).

SSR-safe: `isSupported` is `false` and every control is a no-op when the API
or DOM is unavailable.
Automatic cleanup: any active session is aborted on unmount.

### SpeechSynthesisControls

**Kind:** interface

```typescript
export interface SpeechSynthesisControls
```

Reactive state and controls returned by {@link useSpeechSynthesis}.

### useSpeechSynthesis

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function useSpeechSynthesis(): SpeechSynthesisControls;
```

Framework-neutral text-to-speech hook built on the browser's native
SpeechSynthesis API.

SSR-safe: `isSupported` is `false` and every control is a no-op when the API
or DOM is unavailable.
Automatic cleanup: any in-progress speech is cancelled on unmount.
